clips.title: The story
paras: Innkeeper Gryshka needs a courier to carry her thanks to Zargh at the Crossroads. She sends travelers to Doras the Wind Rider Master at Orgrimmar's skytower to arrange the flight back to the Barrens.

Innkeeper Gryshka sends thanks to Zargh after a shipment of meat arrives safely from the Barrens hunting grounds. With no time to travel through Durotar herself, she trusts the established aerial courier network linking major Horde settlements to carry her letter back across the frontier.

At the flight tower in the Valley of Strength, Doras oversees Orgrimmar's wind rider roost. The trained wyverns carry military messages and supplies between the capital and outposts such as the Crossroads, far faster than anyone traveling by foot or kodo cart.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I've written a letter of thanks to Zargh. Will you deliver it for me? If you've already been to the Crossroads and spoken with their wind rider master, then you can fly a wind rider back there.
Take my letter to Doras, the wind rider master of Orgrimmar, and speak with him about transport to the Crossroads.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Do you need one of my wind riders?

clips.title: Completion
paras: You have to get this to the Crossroads in the Barrens? Yes, I can get you there...
